record.title: Zambia prohibits South African livestock and meat imports through Kazungula
record.scope: Zambian admission prohibition on South African-origin livestock and meat, with Kazungula checkpoint explicitly named; one national policy also reported at other Zambian checkpoints
record.crossings: Kazungula international river-ferry frontier; source also names Livingstone and Chirundu
record.direction: Botswana to Zambia, affecting South African-origin livestock and meat products in transit
record.movement: South African-origin livestock and meat products; named Kazungula enforcement concerns transit via Botswana, not a ban on Botswana-origin cargo.
record.imposing_authority: Zambia Ministry of Fisheries and Livestock; Minister Kampamba Mulenga-Chewe; Southern Province Veterinary Officer Muzumbwe Kanemanema
record.enforcement: Provincial veterinary officer reported checkpoints enforcing the ministerial prohibition in a NAIS interview; universal implementation not independently observed.
record.relationship: Reconciles frozen blinded candidate BLIND-R12-BWA-ZMB-2019-01 against Round11 baseline. One national ban; named checkpoints are not separate duplicate events.
record.status_observation: Historical official implementation report dated 2019-01-22; no persistence inferred beyond that report.
record.official_rationale: Animal disease control following foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in Limpopo, South Africa.
record.context: Commodity-selective admission prohibition. Animal health is explicit; human public health and protectionist intent are not established, so no six-code rationale is forced.
record.uncertainty: Exact start and end unknown. National ban reported by January 14; Kazungula enforcement reported January 22. These are evidence dates, not onset. Independent reporting supports national policy, not direct observation at Kazungula. No general passenger closure or uninterrupted interval inferred.

historical.duration_note: Neither exact endpoints nor continuous duration established.
